{{Quote|First, send a Death Watch assassin to Coruscant. The Duchess of Mandalore must die.|Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]]|<ref name="DoM" />}}
A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] Mandalorian''' was part of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A right hand man of [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], the leader of the Death Watch forces based around the moon of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]], he was sent to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] based on a suggestion by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to assassinate the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] of Mandalore, [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], leader of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] reformist movement.

==Biography==
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he and other [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] guarded the [[Death Watch hideout]] on the moon [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]]. The Death Watch, under the leadership of [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], the [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Concordia, were mobilizing their soldiers for a complete takeover of the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], which was ruled by a reformist faction known as the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]. Vizsla, under guidance of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], who supported the Death Watch, sent the assassin to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Galactic Capital, to kill the leader of the movement, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of [[Kalevala/Legends|Kalevala]], in order to keep her from interfering with their plans.
[[File: DeathWatchAssassin-DOM.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Assassinating Davu Golec]]
The assassin first attempted to take the Duchess's life by planting an explosive inside her [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], activated with a remote detonator. The explosion was only large enough to destroy the speeder's engines, and the Duchess and her guards vaulted out of the vehicle before it crashed into the side of a skytower. However, no proof of the assassin's existence was available to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], leading them to believe the crash was merely an accident. Following the botched attempt on Satine's life, the assassin attempted to kill Satine and a contact of hers, [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]], using a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]]. The assassin killed Golec with a shot to the heart, but the ensuing confusion prevented him from getting a shot on the Duchess. The assassin gave pursuit for a few minutes before losing track.

The assassin eventually caught up with Satine, who was now under the protection of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. He attempted to kill the Duchess using a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], but Kenobi intervened and [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force pushed]] her out of the blast radius. Kenobi and the assassin brawled until the assassin was overwhelmed by Kenobi's use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], prompting him to activate his [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and retreat.

==Equipment==
LIke many of his fellow Mandalorian warriors, the assassin wore a set of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] with a [[Z-6 jetpack/Legends|Z-6 jetpack]]. He carried a sniper rifle and [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|Electrobinoculars]], along with a thermal detonator, a [[GALAAR-15 blaster carbine/Legends|GALAAR-15 blaster carbine]] and a [[WESTAR-35 blaster pistol/Legends|WESTAR-35 blaster pistol]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Mandalorian Death Watch assassin was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voices all of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.
